messages.subject: [R-sig-ins] Earthquake Models in R
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I need to do some basic work to understand the potential insurance costs of
claims arising from earthquates across our property portfolios in various
countries.

In each case I will have a set of geocoded data with the value of the
properties we insure at each longtitude/latitude.  I will also have a set
of historic earthquake information.  Has something already been done in an
R library which would help estimate the costs for each historic quake
(assuming say all properties within a given radius get damaged as some
function of the strength of the quake and distance from the epicentre)?

Also, do you know if anyone has published datasets within R of historic
earthquake catalogs?

Many thanks

Alan Chalk
